```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      debug:
        description: 'Enable debug logging'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  diagnose-tokens:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN
        id: check-agent-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN is set"
            # Validate format (basic check for GitHub token prefix)
            if [[ "${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}" == ghp_* ]] || [[ "${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}" == github_pat_* ]]; then
              echo "status=valid" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "status=invalid_format" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          else
            echo "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN is NOT set"
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN
        id: check-aw-github-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN is set"
            if [[ "${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}" == ghp_* ]] || [[ "${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}" == github_pat_* ]]; then
              echo "status=valid" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "status=invalid_format" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          else
            echo "GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT set"
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check GITHUB_TOKEN
        id: check-default-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set (inherited)"
            echo "status=valid" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT set"
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Determine Effective Token Chain
        run: |
          echo "=== Token Fallback Chain Analysis ==="
          echo "1. GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-agent-token.outputs.status }}"
          echo "2. GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-aw-github-token.outputs.status }}"
          echo "3. GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-default-token.outputs.status }}"
          echo ""
          
          if [ "${{ steps.check-agent-token.outputs.status }}" == "valid" ]; then
            echo "Effective Token: GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN"
          elif [ "${{ steps.check-aw-github-token.outputs.status }}" == "valid" ]; then
            echo "Effective Token: GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN"
          elif [ "${{ steps.check-default-token.outputs.status }}" == "valid" ]; then
            echo "Effective Token: GITHUB_TOKEN"
          else
            echo "ERROR: No valid tokens found in the chain!"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Test Token Permissions (if available)
        if: steps.check-agent-token.outputs.status == 'valid' || steps.check-aw-github-token.outputs.status == 'valid' || steps.check-default-token.outputs.status == 'valid'
        env:
          TEST_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN || secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Testing token permissions..."
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token $TEST_TOKEN" \
               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
               https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs | \
               jq '.total_count' || echo "Failed to fetch workflow runs"
```
